text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama! I heard you've decided your
trip
itinerary!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You're well informed, El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Well, my ears are like antennas!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our long-term trip is gradually drawing
nearer.
Our plan this time is to head
abroad as soon as
spring is finished.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer, have you managed
to get in
contact with my acquaintance?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While we're abroad, we'll be living in an

unfamiliar environment, so the more
people we
know the better.
choice_data_list: ああ、通話アプリで挨拶もできたよ
うん、通話アプリで挨拶もできたよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention, the person is someone
El Condor
Pasa introduced us to. It's a
huge bonus knowing
your connections
are dependable.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! Nakayama, now that we're
finished with
training, lemme give you a
crash course in French!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: First, how about a phrase you can use for any situation? La victoire est à moi!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Don't get too cocky. You're not fooling me. I've already studied up on a few phrases.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Maybe... take a breather first.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! Cafe?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You need to alleviate some of your
fatigue... Why
don't you make a trip?
...Somewhere relaxing.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, I didn't realize you two were
friends.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we started hanging out after Fan
Fest.
She's got a really comfortable
setup in her dorm
room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, it comes back to me! I open
up my
wallet and pull out the hot spring
vacation
coupon we won a while before.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's right. We won that in a New Year
raffle last
year.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Are you thinking I've achieved enough
that we
can put it to use?

text_block_list.name: Inn Customer A
text_block_list.text: Hm... oh, Nakayama Festa?!
choice_data_list: ああ、旅行券の賭けは君の勝ち
うん、旅行券の賭けは貴方の勝ち

text_block_list.name: Inn Customer B
text_block_list.text:
It really is! Sh-she must be here in secret!
We have
to keep our voices down!

text_block_list.name: Inn Customer B
text_block_list.text:
She's bearing the weight of Japan on her
shoulders, so
the least we can do is give
her some space to relax in
private!

text_block_list.name: Inn Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Right! That's the best way we can
support her!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I can hear everything they're saying.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm going to hop in the hot water
and relax.
choice_data_list: その気遣いをいただいて、休もうか

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The hot water really helped loosen up
my
shoulders. My whole body feels a lot
lighter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I go to switch on the air conditioner and
pull my
laptop out of my bag.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Whew... The water felt great.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh nice, you've got the AC on. You're so

considerate.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, c'mon, it's just me. And don't tell me
you're in
work-mode right now...
choice_data_list: そして君は俺の部屋に自然と入ってくるな
そして貴方は私の部屋に自然と入ってくるね

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ping!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I receive a message notification on my
phone. The
address on the screen
belongs to El Condor Pasa's

acquaintance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt... Bzzzt...
choice_data_list: ああ、いくつか返信しておきたくて
うん、いくつか返信しておきたくて

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, now my phone's going off. Laurel
and Spe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt... Bzzzt...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, leave me alone. It's a message
from
Coach, and another from Jordan.
This one with
the weird title must be
Golshi.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: They just keep coming in.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I know... Here's one from El, one from
Cafe.
Another one from the guests we
bumped into in
the inn.
choice_data_list: その分、期待されているってことだよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt! Bzzzt!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And a message from El's friend—the one
you've
been talking to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt! Bzzzt!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt! Bzzzt!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Would they just stop it already! Hey,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We're heading out! Leave your laptop
and phone
here in the room!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Today is supposed to be a day off,
right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy that everyone has their hopes
pinned
on me, but, man, is it a
headache.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
All these interview requests and then
sponsors
breathing down my neck.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Imagine if I ran away here and then you
had to
answer for it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Sure is. The moment I feel really
cornered, I might
just up and disappear.
choice_data_list: プレッシャーが大きい？

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: If I did, would you run away too?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look. The waves are really beautiful.
Trainer!
Hey, gimme your hand!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa takes me by the hand
and leads
me away from the sandy
beach, further into the
ocean water.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We run knee deep into the water, and
then we
both fall over.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: We're both drenched. Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our clothes are soaked through and our
shoes
make a squelching sound as we
walk. Despite
having just gotten clean in
the hot spring water,
the salty wind
makes our bodies feel sticky and
damp.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I knew that you wouldn't let go of my
hand.
choice_data_list: どうしてこんなことを……

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I figured that the person who shares the
same
dream with me would dive with me
into the ocean
if that's where I went.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let's go and get drenched again
sometime.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Nakayama Festa and I have
formed
an irreplaceable bond during our
time together.
